# Direct pair certificate for the exact averaged endpoint

Root derivation, 16 October 2026. Base Astra revision `adb0a306e9bfdc33b9fbd105efb58baed0cc021e`. This is internal mathematical work, not external validation, historical originality, an acquired physical model or a practical superiority claim.

The supplied two-sided Duhamel theorem is the receiving premise. The new construction takes its fast-rate limit **inside the certificate**, retaining the boundary escape term. It removes the need to choose an artificial finite boost and separately certify boosted-component mixing. Ordinary finite-dimensional stochastic averaging and block resolvent algebra are established machinery.

## 1. Exact input and target

Let r be fixed nonnegative symmetric interchange rates on a finite vertex set. Choose additional nonnegative symmetric fast rates a. The positive-rate components of a are the declared blocks C. A block may be a singleton; every nonsingleton block is connected in the supplied fast graph. Let B contain the unchanged rates on edges outside the support of a. On a fast edge replace r_e by W a_e, retaining all other original rates. Thus the boosted generator is W A+B, with W>0. The original rates inside a block but outside the support of a remain in B.

Let Pi average uniformly over within-block permutations. For every T>0 the boosted interchange endpoint converges to

```
P_average(T) = Pi exp[-T Pi B Pi] Pi.
```

This is the standard conditional-uniform boundary-event sampler on the **actual fast connected components**, not on an arbitrary index suffix. The claim is uniform full endpoint total variation over deterministic initial permutations, and therefore over their mixtures and all color projections. It is not a trajectory, current or relative rare-event certificate. Supplied rates and all sampling/output costs remain required.

## 2. Pair objects available without a permutation state space

# Scientific workload audit: no justified new enabled operation

Date: 2026-10-16. Worker: ge_scientific_workload. All original research packets
were treated read-only. No installs, acquired executable code, outreach, Git
operations, or subagents were used.

## Decision

One published scientific workload exactly satisfies the original interchange
hypotheses and needs full permutation/cycle information: the u=1 subcase of
Barp et al.'s 3D cycle-distribution study. It does not justify promoting the
delivered certifier as a new enabling operation. An equally informed exact
endpoint sampler is already O(n) expected events at its studied horizons,
whereas the delivered exterior implementation does not cover its branching grid.
Whole-cube conditional shuffling is provably wrong by more than .5 in full TV
on the published beta<=1, L>=80 regime. This is a scoped rejection, not a lower
bound against every conceivable cycle-specific approximation.

Quantum random-SWAP consensus gives a rigorous and potentially reusable diamond-
norm transfer. This search did not acquire an actual finite-time full-channel
decision with supplied heterogeneous rates, a scientifically owned tolerance,
complete physical-error bounds, and a demonstrated win over exact/averaged
incumbents. Asymptotic twirling and reduced-state consensus already have cheaper
same-information solutions.

Consequential new operation/decision enabled: **NOT_ESTABLISHED**.
Historical novelty: **UNKNOWN**. Physical capability: **UNKNOWN**.
Practical superiority: **NOT_ESTABLISHED**. No material data are asserted.

## The concrete full-output scientific workload

[Barp, Barp, Briol, Ueltschi](https://wrap.warwick.ac.uk/id/eprint/75301/),
*A numerical study of the 3D random interchange and random loop models*,
J. Phys. A 48 (2015) 345002,
[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1088/1751-8113/48/34/345002),
[arXiv:1505.00983v2](https://arxiv.org/html/1505.00983v2), dated 2015-07-14.
Their u=1 model has independent rate-1 nearest-neighbor transpositions on a cube
at horizon beta. Their scientific outputs include the joint cycle/shadow-length
partition and its moments, with cubes L=80 and L=160; a displayed full-partition
sample uses beta=1. They report numerical critical parameters in [0.313,0.361]
across their model family. Their double-bar variants and quantum-spin ensembles
weighted by 2^(number of loops) are different measures.

# GE continuation handoff: precise investments and stopping rules

Source pin `adb0a306e9bfdc33b9fbd105efb58baed0cc021e`; all scientific claims remain externally unreviewed. Read REPORT.md first, then the literal proof relevant to the receiving question. Source=DATA. Do not inherit another model's robustness without an explicit receiving argument.

1. **Reciprocal endpoint theorem and fast boundary — continue, independent verification first.** The exact receiving operation is the fixed-support full-endpoint TV modulus in reciprocal edge rates, with c_C=|C|(|C|-1)/4, and its unique zero-reciprocal limit. Independently reconstruct the two-sided permutation inversion identity, Green normalization and infinite-rate identification. A legal common-support counterexample to any factor invalidates the theorem. Historical search must confront general group-walk perturbation and conductance monotonicity literature, not just titles. Investigate whether c_C^2 can be improved with a genuine graph/edge interaction norm; do not advertise sharpness of the present coarse constant.

2. **Direct averaging + positive Erlang — continue only toward a valuable receiving decision.** The complete target is the exact averaged full endpoint, bounded by the atom PLUS boundary escape convolution. root/DIRECT_AVERAGING_CERTIFICATE.md gives the operation; root/direct_average.py and independent root audit give exact unit-time receipts. A legal three-vertex counterexample forbids dropping boundary escape. Next strongest test: an actually supplied stiff, correlated scientific endpoint observable where a partition passes tolerance and total setup/output/random-bit cost beats validated rational Krylov/CRAM, exact SSA and equally informed direct averaging. Branching is allowed for this resolvent certificate; path exterior assumptions are unnecessary. Partition search and acquisition must be charged. The root prototype is a finite-input certificate, not a graph-uniform optimal solver.
